summary: {clerk} returns to names without a vote after finishing the first pass through the membership.
realLife: Swanson remembered a second call for representatives who had yet to answer the first one. House Rule XX directs the clerk to call the unrecorded members again in surname order. The October 1999 chair emphasized that the alphabetical vote would supply the sole result on the resolution.
gates: The chamber is taking this vote by oral roll call.
inGame: needs: the first call and the unmarked names.

turns.pulledBy: The member hears the second call.
turns.writesBack: The tally gains the missing entry.

turns.pulledBy: The member has yet to arrive.
turns.what: The clerk goes on to the next blank.
turns.writesBack: The member still has no recorded vote.
